journal: Initialized React 18+ / Vite / TypeScript frontend project skeleton in frontend/. Configured strict TypeScript compiler options with moduleResolution=bundler and JSX support. Implemented Vite dev proxy for /api endpoints. Created domain contracts in types/index.ts mirroring backend Pydantic schemas, and built an SSE streaming client in services/api.ts using Fetch ReadableStream to support POST payloads. Structured UI into Header, QueryInput, CitationDrawer, and ResponseView with custom HSL design system tokens, avoiding external CSS framework bloat and adhering to strict LOC limits (<250 LOC/file). Added core Python validation module in src/core/frontend.py and comprehensive unit tests.

glossary.Server-Sent Events (SSE): Unidirectional HTTP-based streaming protocol used to stream token deltas, citation metadata, and stream lifecycle events from FastAPI to React in real time.
glossary.Vite Dev Server Proxy: Development-time HTTP proxy forwarding API requests from frontend port 5173 to backend ASGI server at port 8000.
glossary.Citation Drawer: A presentation component displaying interactive source document citations, page numbers, relevance scores, and text excerpts.
glossary.FinOps Telemetry: Execution metrics tracking token usage, estimated USD costs, latency, and cache hits per interaction.

questions.question: Why use fetch with ReadableStream instead of native EventSource for SSE chat streaming?
questions.answer: Native browser EventSource only supports GET requests and cannot transmit structured JSON bodies or custom headers. Using fetch() with a ReadableStreamDefaultReader allows sending POST /api/v1/chat with ChatRequest while decoding SSE event blocks as they arrive.

questions.question: How is contract parity maintained between Python backend models and TypeScript frontend types?
questions.answer: Domain models in src/models/chat.py are mirrored as TypeScript interfaces in frontend/src/types/index.ts. Automated test suite tests/unit/test_frontend.py inspects Python model fields against TypeScript definitions to prevent contract drift.

questions.question: What is the architectural advantage of using Vanilla CSS custom properties over a heavy UI framework?
questions.answer: Vanilla CSS eliminates bundle bloat and third-party styling churn, ensures fast build times, and enforces custom HSL design tokens and accessible micro-interactions tailored specifically to corporate document assistance.

code.streamChat: POSTs ChatRequest to /api/v1/chat -> decodes streaming Uint8Array chunks via TextDecoder -> parses SSE events (metadata, token, done, error) -> invokes streaming UI callbacks.
code.validate_frontend_setup: Audits frontend directory for mandatory files, package.json scripts and dependencies, and validates presence of required TypeScript interfaces.
